title: mri_segstats
description: Calculates measures and stats derived from brain segmentation data.

segvol.description: Input segmentation volume. This volume's voxel values indicate a segmentation or class.
segvol.title: Segmentation volume

annot_subject.description: Create a segmentation from hemi.parc.annot. Subject is the name of the subject.
annot_subject.title: Annotation subject

slabel_subject.description: Create a segmentation from the given surface label. The points in the label are given a value of 1; 0 for outside.
slabel_subject.title: Surface label subject

output_file.description: ASCII file in which summary statistics are saved.
output_file.title: Output file

partial_vol_comp.description: Use pvvol to compensate for partial voluming, resulting in more accurate volumes.
partial_vol_comp.title: Partial volume compensation volume

input_volume.description: Input volume from which to compute more statistics.
input_volume.title: Input volume

frame.description: Report statistics of the input volume at the specified 0-based frame number.
frame.title: Frame number

robust.description: Compute stats after excluding a percentage of high and low values.
robust.title: Robust percentage

square_input.description: Compute the square of the input before computing stats.
square_input.title: Square input

sqrt_input.description: Compute the square root of the input before computing stats.
sqrt_input.title: Square root input

snr_column.description: Save mean/std as extra column in output table.
snr_column.title: Save SNR column

absolute_value.description: Compute absolute value of input before spatial average.
absolute_value.title: Absolute value

color_table.description: FreeSurfer color table file to specify how each segmentation index is mapped to a segmentation name and color.
color_table.title: Color table file

default_color_table.description: Use default color table from FreeSurferColorLUT.txt.
default_color_table.title: Use default color table

gca_color_table.description: Get color table from the given GCA file.
gca_color_table.title: GCA color table file

exclude_ids.description: Exclude the given segmentation id(s) from report.
exclude_ids.title: Exclude IDs

exclude_gm_wm.description: Exclude cortical gray and white matter based on predefined IDs.
exclude_gm_wm.title: Exclude cortical GM and WM

surf_wm_vol.description: Compute cortical matter volume based on the white surface volume.
surf_wm_vol.title: Surface-based WM volume

no_global_stats.description: Turns off computation of global stats.
no_global_stats.title: No global stats

empty_segments.description: Report on segmentations listed in the color table even if they are not found in the segmentation volume.
empty_segments.title: Report empty segmentations

ctab_output.description: Create an output color table with just the segmentations reported.
ctab_output.title: Output color table

mask_volume.description: Exclude voxels that are not in the mask. Voxels to be excluded are assigned a segid of 0.
mask_volume.title: Mask volume

mask_threshold.description: Exclude voxels that are below thresh, above -thresh, or between -thresh and +thresh.
mask_threshold.title: Mask threshold

mask_sign.description: Specify sign for masking threshold. Choices are abs, pos, and neg.
mask_sign.title: Mask sign

mask_frame.description: Derive the mask volume from the specified 0-based frame.
mask_frame.title: Mask frame

invert_mask.description: After applying all the masking criteria, invert the mask.
invert_mask.title: Invert mask

mask_erode.description: Erode mask by specified number of iterations.
mask_erode.title: Erode mask

brain_vol_seg.description: Get volume of brain as the sum of the volumes of the segmentations that are in the brain.
brain_vol_seg.title: Brain volume from segmentation

brain_mask_vol.description: Load brain mask and compute brain volume from non-zero voxels.
brain_mask_vol.title: Brain mask volume

subcortical_gray.description: Compute volume of subcortical gray matter.
subcortical_gray.title: Subcortical gray matter volume

total_gray.description: Compute volume of total gray matter.
total_gray.title: Total gray matter volume

intracranial_volume_only.description: Compute intracranial volume from talairach.xfm and exit.
intracranial_volume_only.title: Intracranial volume only

old_intracranial_volume_only.description: Compute intracranial volume from talairach_with_skull.lta and exit.
old_intracranial_volume_only.title: Old intracranial volume only

talairach_transform.description: Specify path to talairach.xfm file for eTIV.
talairach_transform.title: Talairach transform file

xfm_to_etiv.description: Convert xfm to eTIV and write to output file.
xfm_to_etiv.title: Transform to eTIV

euler_hole_count.description: Write out number of defect holes based on the Euler number.
euler_hole_count.title: Euler hole count

avg_waveform.description: Compute the average waveform and save to text file.
avg_waveform.title: Average waveform file

sum_waveform.description: Compute the sum waveform and save to text file.
sum_waveform.title: Sum waveform file

avg_waveform_vol.description: Compute average waveform and save to MRI volume.
avg_waveform_vol.title: Average waveform volume file

remove_avgwf_mean.description: Remove temporal mean from avgwf and avgwfvol.
remove_avgwf_mean.title: Remove avgwf temporal mean

spatial_frame_avg.description: Save mean across space and frame.
spatial_frame_avg.title: Spatial frame average file

voxel_crs.description: Replace segmentation with all 0s except at specified voxel.
voxel_crs.title: Voxel CRS

replace_ids_file.description: Replace segmentations based on pairs in file.
replace_ids_file.title: Replace IDs file

gtm_default_seg_merge.description: Replace segmentations based on GTM default.
gtm_default_seg_merge.title: GTM default segmentation merge

gtm_default_seg_merge_choroid.description: Replace segmentations based on GTM default excluding choroid.
gtm_default_seg_merge_choroid.title: GTM default segmentation merge choroid

qa_stats_file.description: Compute stats useful for quality control.
qa_stats_file.title: QA statistics file

random_seed.description: Set random number generator seed value.
random_seed.title: Random seed
